claim.summary: Over a field, R=k[x], J the degree-D' closure, rho:R->Mat_k(R) by commuting rho(x_i) of entry degree <=T>=1, nu a twisted repair at window D-K (soundness on axiom multiples within D-K, killing rho(wE_i)nu in J^k for deg(wE_i)<=D-K, survival rho(w)nu notin J^k), u_1=rho(x_1)nu, u_0=nu-u_1. (a) With Boolean axioms on x_1..x_t, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>t and room T(D-K)+deg nu<=D': rho(g)nu = rho(g|x1=0)u_0+rho(g|x1=1)u_1, and for deg g<=D-K-1 membership splits, so a vector u_eps is a twisted repair of the substituted map at window D-K-1 (soundness and killing of degree D-K dropped), room unchanged; after t splits some coordinate of some u_sigma is a substitution repair of x_1..x_t at window D-K-(t-s) when the room is T(D-K)+sT+deg nu. (b) If x_1..x_s are twisted, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>s, each x_i-l_i is an axiom with l_i of degree <=1 in untwisted variables, and D-K+deg nu<=D', then rho(g)nu = g nu mod J^k for deg g<=D-K: a scalar repair at the full window, with no Boolean axiom and no entry bound. (c) In a domain model (J the degree-<=D' polynomials vanishing on finite X), with x_1^2-x_1 an axiom and D-K>=2, the split pieces of every g of degree <=D-K vanish on X with degree <=T(D-K)+T+deg nu: the full window is kept, measured at degree D'+T, survival unchanged.

claim.summary: Over a field, for R=k[x], axioms a_j, a filtered R-module N (any generators and relations) with a degree-D pseudo-submodule J_N, errors E_i, protected w and nu in F_K N with b+K<=D and deg(wE_i)+K<=D, call nu a module repair when a_j m nu in J_N for deg(a_j m)<=D-K, w E_i nu in J_N and w nu not in J_N. Maps compatible with multiplication modulo J_N are multiplication by nu modulo J_N. If a linear beta from F_D N into a filtered commutative algebra S carries J_N into J' (closed under each phi(x_i)), is compatible up to a k-algebra map phi:R->S with degree bounds, and beta(w nu) is not in J', then beta(nu) is an S-valued repair of the phi-image system; for S=R and phi the identity a scalar repair of the old system at no larger degree; free modules with matrix-preimage closures yield (B nu)_l at parameter K; for N=R/I the certificates are f with If in J' modulo J'. First-order differential certificates g->g+eps dg into R[eps]/eps^2 with target J+eps J, J the old closure with Boolean axioms on the differentiated variables, soundness reaching them and degree room, yield f0 or f1 as a scalar repair on the window deg(a_j m)<=D-K. Every repair puts w outside the degree-(D-K) closure of the axioms with the weighted errors wE_i added.
